name: Agility PR Solutions
description:
Agility PR Solutions is an enterprise-grade media intelligence platform for communications teams. This connector links Claude to Agility's Media Intelligence API, so you can query media coverage in plain language without custom development. 

You can search Agility's comprehensive media coverage using natural language and you can leverage Claude to generate executive takeaways, analyze sentiment and trends, compare brands and competitors, build charts showing sentiment, share of voice, and coverage over time. 

Answers draw on Agility's verified, structured media data spanning online, print, broadcast, podcast, radio, and social media. Claude signals when it is drawing on Agility data, so every answer has a traceable source. 

Requirements: An Agility account with Media Intelligence API access. 

Contact Us: www.agilitypr.com/contact/

_published_faq.name: How do I add Agility PR Solutions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Agility PR Solutions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://apigateway.agilitypr.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Agility PR Solutions MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agility PR Solutions provides these MCP tools: ad_hoc_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Agility PR Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Agility PR Solutions in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Agility PR Solutions MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agility PR Solutions requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Agility PR Solutions is developed by Agility PR Solutions Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
